Dept. Before Honourable Mr. Justice Manish Choudhury Order
texts.facts: 2 . The petitioner has stated that he is running a restaurant by the name and style of 'Shahi Biryani Hotel' after obtaining a valid license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 from the Commissionerate of Food Safety [Health & Family Welfare Department], Government of Assam, which is valid up-to 20.10.2026. The petitioner has also obtained permission and trade license from Nilbagan Gaon Panchayat to run the restaurant as per the provisions of the Assam Panchayat Raj Act, 1986. Page No.# 3/4 3. The petitioner is aggrieved by an Order dated 26.09.2025 passed by the District Magistrate, Hojai [the respondent no. 5] purportedly in exercise of the powers under Section 152 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita [BNSS], 2023. The assail is made to the impugned Order on the ground Md. Fakrul Islam vs The State Of Assam And 7 Ors on 17 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150603544/ 2 that by issuing the impugned Order dated 26.09.2025, the respondent no. 5 has illegally closed the restaurant of the petitioner, which is the only means of livelihood of the petitioner. It is submitted that the respondent no. 5 without any enquiry, recorded findings in the impugned Order which are evidently perverse. There is no element of public nuisance and the order has been passed beyond authority and jurisdiction of the respondent no. 5.
texts.arguments: 4. Per contra, the learned State Counsel has submitted that the impugned Order is an order of interim nature as the petitioner has the option to show cause against the Order under Section 154, BNSS and the respondent no. 5 after going through the cause shown can either drop the proceeding or can modify or make the order absolute under Section 157, BNSS.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 4.
